brief.summary_1line: Hanuman rallies fleeing monkeys to battle Indrajit, then withdraws believing Sita dead while Indrajit performs a powerful sacrificial ritual at Nikumbhila.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman hurls a massive rock toward Indrajit's chariot as the charioteer sharply turns the horses and the stone crashes into the earth.
Hundreds of monkeys surround Hanuman, raining trees and boulders onto Indrajit while demons fall beneath the storm of missiles.
At the altar of Nikumbhila, Indrajit pours bloody libations into a blazing fire that glows like the setting sun while demons stand watching.
